verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents international payments in local currencies across 150+ countries and 40+ currencies with no transfer/wire fees, mid-market FX rates, multi-currency accounts, and stablecoin rails claiming reduced FX costs and transparent settlement details (reference IDs, timestamps, on-chain hash). Fee transparency is addressed via 'no transfer fees or wire fees' and mid-market rate claims, though exact fee schedules and independent verification are absent. Missing for 10: independent/third-party corroboration of claimed fee transparency and actual rate competitiveness, and a detailed public fee schedule.
